title: Edit PDF – Add Text, Highlights & Shapes Free, No Upload
description: Edit a PDF in your browser: add text boxes, highlight text, draw, add shapes and pictures, then save a copy. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Edit PDF
subtitle: Add text boxes, highlights, drawings, shapes and pictures to a PDF and save a copy; nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Mark up any page
features.text: Text boxes, highlights over the PDF's own text, freehand drawing, rectangles, ellipses, lines, arrows and pictures.

features.title: Undo and redo
features.text: Every change can be undone and redone, and you are asked before unsaved changes are thrown away.

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page.

steps.title: Pick a tool
steps.text: Choose Text box, Highlight, Draw, a shape or Picture, with a colour and line thickness.

steps.title: Mark up the pages
steps.text: Click or drag on a page. Drag what you placed to move it; drag its corner to resize it.

steps.title: Save a copy
steps.text: Click Save a copy, check the preview and download the edited PDF.

limits: Text already in the PDF can't be rewritten; cover it with a white rectangle and add a text box on top.
PDFs that need a password to open can't be edited; remove the password first.
Shapes and pictures become part of the page; text boxes, highlights and drawings stay editable in other PDF apps.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Can I change the text that is already in the PDF?
faq.answer: No. A PDF stores its text as placed letters, not as paragraphs, so it can't be rewritten here. To change a word, cover it with a white rectangle and type over it with a text box.

faq.question: Is my original file changed?
faq.answer: No. Save a copy makes a new PDF to download; the file on your device stays exactly as it was.

faq.question: Can I undo a change?
faq.answer: Yes. Undo and Redo step back and forward through every change, in the order you made them, until you save.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark of ours and no limit on how often you use it.
